other_items.title: Elder-selection chain source-bound status audit under the owner's five-value taxonomy (CL-ELDER-SELECTION-CHAIN-AUDIT-20261031-v1, v1.2)
other_items.reason: Added since the cut. AUDIT.md calls itself a 'source-bound review record' (l.4). For 23 claims of the elder-selection Theorem A/B/C chain and the lower-bound chain, it assigns one of the owner's five status values (histogram: Conditional 3, Conjectural 4, Proved 10, Proved under assumptions 3, Refuted 3). It records the evidence form and nonauthor readers and lists 37 open obligations. It also lists surface inconsistencies I-1..I-4 and proposes wording for the integrator (section 8, 'not applied here'). CLAIMS.json is its machine-readable claim map. It binds 44 sources by repo/commit/path/blob/bytes/sha256 and records 17 reviews, depends_on, obligations and metrics. Its 'kind' is 'source-bound review record; proposes PROOF_INDEX/STATUS wording for the integrator; not a register' and its 'scientific_effect' is 'NONE'. AUDIT.md l.286-287 says 'No theorem is proved, improved, weakened or withdrawn here. No review verdict is issued on any proof; the statuses summarize located records under a stated rule. No numerical constant is claimed.' Every claim's statement cites named sources. F1 rests on the Math-#543 oneLaw countermodel (CE4-LEAN) together with the register's round-4 triage (REG-SCOPE). F2 rests on the register's own text: the Lifetime.lean l.455-467 docstring and the REG-SCOPE BLOCKED_INTERFACE triage with inhabitants p = 0 and p = 1. C7 rests on Theorem U (U2). Own-voice passages were checked. The Borel remark (AUDIT l.88) restates E2-REPAIR l.96. The bar-count conclusion (l.157-160) composes Theorems C and U and is labelled 'granted F5, a theorem of the project'. CLAIMS.json l.976 remarks that 'a refutation of C7 for elder-selected pairs in place of bars needs no F5'; this is a dependency comment on Theorem U's proof, with no statement or proof of its own. The I-3 byte count (1,743 vs 1,720) is custody. None is presented as a new result. The item reviews and re-classifies named claims.
